core_obligations: Base field (proof lines 1105-1114): closedness of i(G') descends from a perfect extension by 02JY (G_{k'} -> G flat, quasi-compact, surjective); over perfect k the reductions of G and G' are subgroup schemes (047R) and products of reduced schemes are reduced.

Closure is a subgroup (proof lines 1116-1124): for the reduced closure Z of i(G'), Z x_k Z is the closure of the image of G' x G' -> G x G (047B), so m(Z x Z) subset Z by continuity; Z is a reduced closed subgroup scheme.
Equality (proof lines 1126-1128): i(G') is an open subgroup scheme of the group scheme Z (immersion), hence closed in Z by 047S, so i(G') = Z is closed in G.
proof_roadmap: Descend closedness to reduce to perfect k and reduced schemes (proof lines 1105-1114).
Show the reduced closure of the image is a closed subgroup scheme (proof lines 1116-1124).
Conclude the image equals its closure via the open-subgroup lemma (proof lines 1126-1128).
